sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Survivalist Path - Eagle-Owl is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "As I've read in one article, the human eye can get used to the darkness. You know, I wanted to check, and I almost broke my leg in a deadfall. Guess I'm a little old for such a metamorphosis. But you, I think, are in the prime of life. A well-trained night eyesight can help us very much in our difficult tasks. So take care of this. You're a tough guy, you can take a punch. But what if you can't see anything at night and suddenly get ambushed by some scum? Those things happen quite often, not everyone can take NVGs into their raids. So, show me how you see in the dark, without any gadgets."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 6 Scavs in the time period of 21:00-04:00 without using any NVGs or thermal sights (Excluding Factory)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 3× Armasight Vulcan MG 3.5x Bravo night vision scope
- 1× VSS Vintorez 9x39 special sniper rifle
- 4× 9x39mm SPP gs ammo pack (20 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase of VSS/VAL TOZ 6P29M mount at Jaeger LL3
"How many you say there were, six? And you got them all without the "goggles"? Indeed, you are a great night hunter, kid."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 6 Scavs on any map aside from Factory in the time period of 21:00-04:00 without using any night vision devices, thermal vision devices, night vision scopes or thermal vision sights. Equipped but switched off devices still prevent quest progress.
